= The CI/CD Capability Atlas
:toc:
:toclevels: 2

*Repository assurance, organised by purpose. Discover by clade; choose by nature; adopt with evidence.*

*32 composite actions · 8 clades · two independent discovery axes.*

This is a visitor-facing product catalogue, not a repo-chora file, a BoJ cartridge implementation, or a certification scheme. Inspired by BoJ's separation of capability domain from interface/type, it groups existing CI/CD building blocks without moving their paths or changing their behaviour.

== Find your route

* *Protect credentials:* <<sentinel,Sentinel>> — bounded secret scanning and authoritative result receipts.
* *Establish repository policy:* <<covenant,Covenant>>, <<forge,Forge>> and <<schema,Schema>>.
* *Compile, test or prove:* <<proof,Proof>> — language-specific execution and explicitly labelled source checks.
* *Integrate the ecosystem:* <<bridge,Bridge>> — BoJ applicability, Pons and Panic Attack.
* *Explore signals and future work:* <<observatory,Observatory>> and <<frontier,Frontier>> — no inflated assurance claims.

== Read the assurance labels

* *Enforcing (20):* can reject a subject. This is not a guarantee of completeness, applicability, production readiness or formal verification.
* *Tool-dependent (3):* requires explicitly supplied validators/toolchains; inspect applicability and not-run behaviour before adoption.
* *Advisory (7):* signals and warnings, not an assurance verdict. Some current outputs are simulated or heuristic; each card names the boundary.
* *Stub (2):* unfinished integration or placeholder. Do not deploy as evidence of a completed check.

Nature is a separate axis: a policy-pattern scan is not a compiler, a receipt verifier is not an analyser, and a proof executor is not a proof that every program is correct. These labels are reviewed inventory metadata; tests enforce coverage and consistency, not semantic correctness of every gate.

== Adopt deliberately

Start with a reusable workflow/caller template where supplied: it handles orchestration that a bare composite may not. Read the action's inputs, scripts, prerequisites and test controls. Pin an already-published, tested source SHA; update the caller lock and complete dependency closure together. Never turn unavailable tools, absent analysis or skipped work into a green assurance claim.

* link:templates/estate-audit-caller.yml[Estate-audit caller]
* link:.github/workflows/main-estate-audit.yml[Estate-audit orchestration]
* link:docs/SECRET-SCANNER-ROLLOUT.adoc[Secret-scanner rollout and security boundaries]
* link:docs/GOVERNANCE-AND-SONAR-REPAIR.adoc[Governance and Sonar verification guidance]
* link:README.adoc[Operational README, known defects and test guidance]

== Keep the atlas honest

The single inventory is link:catalogue/capabilities.json[catalogue/capabilities.json]. Every action must appear exactly once in one primary clade; status and nature remain independent. Adding an action without cataloguing it, breaking a target link, duplicating an entry or leaving generated pages stale fails the catalogue checks.
